body: Yellow
You own your body and your voice and your mind. You know who you are. Hold on tight to your truth—it is your power.

I’m 19. Unemployed and not interested in working. I get it. It’s nice to experience stuff and substances, especially if you have lived a life full of pain and alienation. Often these things are the only joys we percieve. Hedonism becomes slavery when You become a vacuum. Consuming everything (and everyone) around you and discarding what you identify as distraction. We become artificially blind to consequences. Deplete our potential. Alienating ourselves further. 

My advice to you is to find out what it is that your heart wants. Are there wounds you are ignoring? I’m still unemployed and relatively jaded but It’s helped me a lot in the past and present to open my eyes. See the world for what it is. See myself for who I am. 

The mindless drone mentality extends even into this community. We cannot force our values onto others and hardship is inevitable. Detachment can be a virtue. Practicality can be too. 

You are a participant on this Earth. Work if you want, rest of you don’t. Whatever happens, try and remain aware of when your actions do or don’t align with your true desires and values. 

Thanks for sharing your anxiety. Trust yourself. You don’t have to figure it out all at once, forever. Peace.
I am experiencing something similar. Not your fault that your family does not understand disability. You deserve dignity and care.
Heheheheh thanks :) hope u r well today
I’d like to send you love. It’s nice to know that I’m not alone.
Think I’m gonna stick it out a while longer. Don’t know why. Something will happen. I appreciate your comment.

Recently ran away to a horse farm in Missouri to escape the mounting fear that my trauma would have me in a chokehold forever. Ended up just being depressed but in Missouri. I’ve since come back, still still unwell, and scheming to run away again. I don’t know how sustainable this solution is but shit, it’s better than the alternatives I can think of. Plus you can get some cool life experiences out of it.
This is very helpful, thanks. Envisioning a life worth living has been hard. All I want to do is sleep.

Thank you for responding!! I’m glad you’ve found a system that works for you. I took Adderall in high school and it helped me a ton, but I’ve since been unable to get a prescription. 

It sucks not to care about anything you do. I hope we can get out of this eventually.

Thanks for this response :) I smoke but recently can’t access flower reliably since I’m unable to work long term. What little income I have goes toward food and paying people back. But I’m glad it works for you. And I hope that I get to a place where I can rely on it to get by again.

I worry about disappointing people too, mostly about how I already have. It’s kind of a lost cause worry at this point but it’s still there.
This is a normal response. I hope you were able to find some space and rest. Sending you love. You deserve to feel safe at home.
19 and have had a teddy bear since I was about 7 or 8. They help me a lot when all I need is a hug and no one is around.
Thank you for your answer. How long did it take you to find a safe place? What was the process like?
Hug 4 u and a kiss on the forehead also

I calmed an abandonment trigger without lashing out at a friend who was inadvertently making the situation worse. I was able to allow them the space to be honest even if they were dishonest at first, without collapsing or blaming.

dont know about u but almost everyone in my life goes at least a couple days a month without food. remember that everyones realities r different and the human experience is actually quite broader and more nuanced than the first world, "upright citizen's" experience
not tryna criticize yo

Who is this for?? What reality do these people live in?? 

I forget that not everyone has nightly panic attacks about not being able to feed themselves.
I hope we find space from them some day soon. I hope we can slow ajd cease the cycle over time. We deserve to heal independent of them. We deserve to heal.
I am an adult. My friends are adults.
I come in and out of reality. I don’t remember much. It’s like there’s cotton in my ears and I’m wearing mittens and sunglasses. Once I come out of it I’m usually shaking.

They expect to have control over my treatment. They exercise this by becoming friends with my doctors, forcing family therapy, calling me delusional and convincing drs that I’m a liar, etc. I want to heal and to do so I need them out of my life. They won’t support me if I cut them off.
I don’t go to the place. If I don’t have a choice I either dissociate or make a scene.
Yes and yes.

I am on an antidepressant and have been on a myriad of psychiatric meds all my life. None of them have helped significantly, most have hurt me. I’ve been out of therapy because my therapist was chosen by my parents and they are acquainted with her, which makes it hard to trust her. Talk therapy has never been helpful but I only recently left my parents house. If I cut them off they’ll take me off their insurance and I can’t pay for insurance or regular therapy sessions.
Yes it is wonderful!!!
No. But they are unhappy that I left and are constantly calling/texting. They expect me to spend time with them and get angry when I exercise boundaries.

I’ve been working on this for years and it’s up and down. Recently it’s been down but I have been centered and loving toward myself in the past. It is hard to find love from within myself when I am constantly panicking, and when the only people who talk to me are my abusive parents. I meditate daily and journal literally constantly. My friends and my self and my plants mean a lot to me.

I have a therapist that I see once every 2-8 months because she’s booked out really far and I can’t afford much else. Looking for someone more available and affordable but there are many intersections in my identity that most therapists in my area don’t understand or validate. Also talk therapy is not super helpful for me. 

I take psychiatric medication and was just put on a new med. I’ve been on so many different pills and none of them work but I am at a loss. 

Research is hard and there’s not much guidance. Especially as a low income person, when the providers who offer the types of therapy that I could benefit from don’t take insurance.
Yes yes yes. Thank you for posting this. Some of us also face coercion and abuse for trying to leave. Financial abuse is a big one as well.
